items.context: You are a member of a local running club.
items.prompt: Tell us why you joined the club and how often you would like to run with the group. Write in sentences. Use 20–30 words.

b2.text: I joined the club because I wanted to get fit and meet new people. I would like to run with the group twice a week, but weekends are best.

note.en: A simple, clear connector to give your reason.
note.es: Conector sencillo y claro para dar el motivo.

note.en: A natural everyday collocation for improving your fitness.
note.es: Colocación natural y cotidiana para mejorar la forma física.

note.en: Answers 'how often' with a clear frequency expression.
note.es: Responde a «how often» con una expresión de frecuencia clara.

note.en: 'But' adds a contrast and a useful preference.
note.es: «But» añade un contraste y una preferencia útil.

c.text: Having struggled to stay motivated alone, I joined hoping for company. What I'd really like is to run with the group twice a week, ideally at dawn.

annotations.quote: Having struggled to stay motivated alone

note.en: A perfect participle clause gives the reason without 'because'.
note.es: Una cláusula de participio perfecto da el motivo sin usar «because».

note.en: 'Company' here means having people with you, a more precise word than 'friends'.
note.es: «Company» significa tener gente cerca; es más preciso que «friends».

note.en: A cleft sentence puts the focus on your wish.
note.es: Una oración hendida pone el énfasis en lo que deseas.

note.en: 'Ideally' softens the request and sounds polite.
note.es: «Ideally» suaviza la petición y suena educado.

items.context: You are a member of a community book club.
items.prompt: Describe a book you have enjoyed recently and say why you would recommend it to the group. Write in sentences. Use 20–30 words.

b2.text: I recently read a crime novel set in Lisbon. I would recommend it because the plot is exciting and the characters feel very real.

note.en: Naming the genre precisely makes the description clearer.
note.es: Nombrar el género con precisión hace la descripción más clara.

note.en: A reduced relative clause adds the setting in two words.
note.es: Una oración de relativo reducida añade el escenario en pocas palabras.

note.en: Links the recommendation to its reason.
note.es: Une la recomendación con su motivo.

note.en: 'And' adds a second reason.
note.es: «And» añade una segunda razón.

c.text: Set in Lisbon, the novel I've just finished is a gripping thriller. Not only is the plot ingenious, but the characters are also remarkably vivid, so I'd recommend it.

note.en: A past participle phrase opens the sentence and saves a clause.
note.es: Una frase de participio abre la oración y ahorra una cláusula.

note.en: A strong, precise collocation instead of 'good book'.
note.es: Colocación fuerte y precisa en lugar de «good book».

annotations.quote: Not only is the plot ingenious, but

note.en: Inversion after 'Not only' adds emphasis and a second reason.
note.es: La inversión tras «Not only» da énfasis y añade una segunda razón.

note.en: An intensifying adverb with a precise adjective.
note.es: Un adverbio intensificador con un adjetivo preciso.

items.context: You are a member of a university film society.
items.prompt: Say what kind of films you would like the society to show and explain why. Write in sentences. Use 20–30 words.

b2.text: I would like the society to show more foreign films. They teach me about other cultures, and I can also practise my English with subtitles.

annotations.quote: I would like the society to show

note.en: A polite way to make a request in a club.
note.es: Forma educada de hacer una petición en un club.

note.en: A clear, common collocation for films in other languages.
note.es: Colocación clara y común para películas en otros idiomas.

note.en: Adds a second benefit to the first.
note.es: Suma un segundo beneficio al primero.

c.text: I'd love the society to screen more world cinema, preferably films we'd never otherwise see. Doing so would broaden everyone's horizons and spark lively debates afterwards.

note.en: A more precise term than 'foreign films'.
note.es: Término más preciso que «foreign films».

note.en: 'Otherwise' implies a condition without a full if-clause.
note.es: «Otherwise» implica una condición sin necesidad de una cláusula con «if».

note.en: A gerund subject plus 'so' refers back to the idea neatly.
note.es: Un gerundio como sujeto más «so» retoma la idea anterior con elegancia.

note.en: A fixed phrase for learning about new things.
note.es: Expresión fija para ampliar conocimientos y perspectivas.

note.en: Strong verb and adjective collocation.
note.es: Colocación potente de verbo y adjetivo.

items.context: You are a member of an after-work coding club.
items.prompt: Tell us what you are working on at the moment and what you find difficult. Write in sentences. Use 20–30 words.

b2.text: I'm building a small app to plan my weekly meals. The hardest part is fixing errors, because I often can't find where the problem is.

note.en: Present continuous for a project in progress.
note.es: Presente continuo para un proyecto en curso.

note.en: A clear way to introduce the main difficulty.
note.es: Forma clara de presentar la dificultad principal.

note.en: Simple, natural technical vocabulary.
note.es: Vocabulario técnico sencillo y natural.

note.en: Explains why the task is hard.
note.es: Explica por qué la tarea es difícil.

c.text: I'm currently developing an app that tailors weekly meal plans to dietary needs. What I find trickiest is debugging; tracking down a single faulty line can take hours.

note.en: 'Developing' and 'currently' sound more professional than 'making' and 'now'.
note.es: «Developing» y «currently» suenan más profesionales que «making» y «now».

note.en: A precise verb meaning 'adapts to suit'.
note.es: Verbo preciso que significa «adapta a medida».

note.en: A cleft sentence that highlights the difficulty.
note.es: Una oración hendida que destaca la dificultad.

annotations.quote: tracking down a single faulty line

note.en: A gerund phrase as the subject, with a phrasal verb.
note.es: Un gerundio como sujeto, con un phrasal verb.

items.context: You are a member of a hiking and travel club.
items.prompt: Suggest a place for the club's next weekend trip and say what members could do there. Write in sentences. Use 20–30 words.

b2.text: I suggest we go to the Picos de Europa. We could walk along the river in the morning, and then relax in a village café.

note.en: A friendly, neutral way to propose a plan to a group.
note.es: Forma amable y neutra de proponer un plan a un grupo.

note.en: 'Could' offers an idea without sounding bossy.
note.es: «Could» ofrece una idea sin sonar autoritario.

note.en: Puts the activities in order.
note.es: Ordena las actividades en el tiempo.

c.text: How about the Picos de Europa? Should the weather hold, we could hike to a mountain lake and, afterwards, unwind over a hearty meal in a traditional village.

annotations.quote: How about the Picos de Europa?

note.en: A short, informal question that invites the group to agree.
note.es: Pregunta breve e informal que invita al grupo a opinar.

note.en: Inversion replaces 'If the weather holds' and sounds more polished.
note.es: La inversión sustituye a «If the weather holds» y suena más elaborada.

note.en: Shows the order of the plan neatly.
note.es: Marca el orden del plan de forma limpia.

note.en: A vivid, natural phrase instead of 'relax and eat'.
note.es: Frase viva y natural en lugar de «relax and eat».
